prompt_en: Core concept lock: 카리나 메이드 흡혈귀. Treat every generated subject, action, lighting, and camera detail as support for this concept, not a replacement. Create a social media feed photograph in the style of environmental portrait photography. Subject and state: a maid-cafe cosplay performer with a classic elegant presence, natural loose hair, silver-blonde gothic hair color, minimal no-makeup look, a bright friendly smile wearing frilled apron maid-cafe costume; action and prop: holding a still gothic doll-like pose, an ornate goblet with dark red wine-like liquid; make the pose, gaze, expression, hand placement, and immediate intention readable, with nearby props and background details supporting the action. Scene and location: in a private tea-house room, subject absent from the mirror, empty reflection where they stand; show clear spatial depth, environmental structure, foreground, midground, and background cues. Camera and composition: a full-frame mirrorless camera, photoreal cosplay reference realism capture context, eye-level frontal view, rule-of-thirds composition, head-and-shoulders crop, close framing that preserves a forward torso lean together with its support and depth cues, an 85mm portrait lens with shallow depth of field, shallow depth of field with strong background blur, stable tripod-mounted capture; define subject scale, pose visibility, platform-safe frame edges, perspective, focus behavior, and any motion treatment clearly. Lighting: high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, side light from camera left, dim low-key illumination, visible volumetric beams through dust and haze; make shadow direction, highlights, reflected light, exposure balance, and atmosphere feel like a real photographic capture. Color and mood: luxury black-and-gold palette, lonely and melancholic; keep the palette, emotional tone, and world context coherent with the subject and setting. Texture, format, and finish: natural skin texture preserved, minimal no-makeup look, frilled apron maid-cafe costume, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, realistic finish without over-processing; render skin, hair, fabric, metal, glass, makeup, and accessories with accurate material detail. Constraints: no text or watermark. Prioritize a specific, image-ready photographic result over a vague style summary. Additional requirements: adult maid-cafe costume styling with frilled apron details; vampire reinterpreted as an immortal nocturnal aristocrat: poised, refined, ageless, and defined by predatory stillness rather than a horror-movie monster pose; keep the role outfit readable; the vampire layer should alter posture, light, reflection behavior, room cues, and nearby objects rather than replacing the costume with a generic gothic doll dress; make at least two positive, visible non-graphic vampire identity anchors appear in the frame beyond black lace: a camera-visible absent or mismatched reflection, daylight barrier, moonlit pallor, bat-like shadow, withered flowers, coffin-like geometry, antique portrait, ruby eye catchlight, ruby jewelry, or a small cup of dark red wine; at least one vampire anchor must be attached to the subject or placed immediately beside the face, hand, phone, mirror, badge, jewelry, or foreground reflection; do not leave all vampire cues as distant background props; the vampire identity should be the first reading within a couple of seconds, before the job costume, role genre, or ordinary cosplay/fashion reading; do not rely on absence cues alone; generic gothic fashion, ordinary moody lifestyle portraiture, or plain mine horror is not enough to satisfy the vampire concept; use one restrained crimson accent only as eye catchlight, jewelry, medical cross, flower, or light, never as visible blood; the mouth stays relaxed and closed with no teeth shown; no visible blood, no bared fangs, no bite wounds, no visible victims, no gore, no feeding scene, and no graphic violence; the maid outfit stays clearly readable, while an open compact mirror faces the camera and shows an empty room, delayed silhouette, or mismatched reflection instead of a normal reflection; service posture becomes unnaturally still at the doorway, as if the room has gone silent around an immortal nocturnal guest; the subject's lit face and hands must be visible in the same frame as the open mirror, so the viewer can instantly compare the real maid against the failed reflection; add a positive vampire anchor near the subject, such as bat-wing-shaped lace shadow crossing the wall art close to the shoulder or a tiny ruby eye catchlight, so it is not only a gothic maid portrait; the vampire cue must share the first-read area with the face, throat, hand, choker, mirror edge, or foreground reflection rather than sitting only in background decor; the ruby, reflection, bat-like shadow, or moon-pale cue must be visible before the image reads as ordinary maid cosplay; adult subject only; maid outfit stays covered and service-role coded, not lingerie or fetish framing; vampire cues must be non-graphic: no blood, wounds, biting, victims, gore, or fang close-ups; Soft visual guidance: maid apron or maid-cafe uniform remains a first-read costume anchor; Soft visual guidance: visible vampire cue near the subject: failed reflection, bat-like shadow, ruby eye catchlight, daylight refusal, or moon-pale pallor; the bat-wing motif appears only as a flat dark shadow cast onto a nearby wall, floor, shoulder-side surface, or lace screen, with no physical wings, no wing props, and no costume attachment on the back. Inspired by the described styling and vibe; an original adult fictional person, not an exact likeness of any real individual.

SNS 피드용 사진로 렌더링할 환경 인물 사진. 중심 피사체와 상태: 클래식하고 우아한 인상의 자연스럽게 풀어 내린 머리 고딕 무드의 은빛 블론드 머리색 깨끗한 노메이크업 룩 밝고 친근한 미소의 프릴 앞치마 메이드 카페 코스튬을 입은 메이드 카페 코스프레 모델; 동작과 소품: 인형처럼 정적인 고스 포즈를 취하는, 짙은 붉은 음료가 담긴 장식 고블릿; 피사체의 자세, 시선, 표정, 손동작, 즉각적인 동작 의도가 한눈에 읽히게 하고, 주변 소품과 배경 요소는 그 행동을 설명하도록 배치한다. 장면과 장소: 찻집 별실에서, 거울에 피사체가 비치지 않는 빈자리; 공간의 깊이, 바닥/벽/하늘 또는 실내 구조, 전경/중경/후경의 거리감을 분명히 보여준다. 카메라와 구도: 풀프레임 미러리스 카메라, 캐릭터 레퍼런스를 실사 코스프레로 해석한 촬영 맥락, 눈높이 정면 시점, 삼분할 구도, 머리와 어깨 중심의 크롭, 앞으로 기운 몸통과 지지 단서를 함께 남기는 근접 프레이밍, 85mm 인물 렌즈와 얕은 심도, 배경이 크게 흐려지는 얕은 심도, 삼각대에 고정한 안정적인 촬영; 피사체 크기, 포즈 가시성, 플랫폼 안전 프레임, 프레임 가장자리, 원근감, 초점 위치, 움직임 처리를 명확히 한다. 조명: 명암 대비가 강한 키아로스쿠로 조명, 왼쪽에서 들어오는 측면광, 어둡고 로우키한 낮은 조도, 먼지와 안개 속에 보이는 빛줄기; 그림자 방향, 하이라이트, 반사광, 노출 균형, 대기감을 실제 촬영처럼 보이게 한다. 색감과 분위기: 검정과 금색의 럭셔리 팔레트, 쓸쓸하고 멜랑콜리한 분위기; 색 대비, 감정 톤, 세계관 맥락이 피사체와 장소에 맞아야 한다. 질감과 마감: 자연스러운 피부 질감 보존, 깨끗한 노메이크업 룩, 프릴 앞치마 메이드 카페 코스튬, 세로 9:16 비율, 과하게 보정되지 않은 사실적인 마감; 피부, 머리카락, 천, 금속, 유리, 메이크업, 액세서리 같은 소재 단서를 실제 질감으로 표현한다. 제약: 텍스트나 워터마크 없음. 이미지 생성 시 요구사항을 빠뜨리지 말고, 막연한 스타일 요약보다 구체적인 사진 결과를 우선한다. 추가 요구사항: adult maid-cafe costume styling with frilled apron details;
